subject: MATHEMATICS
purpose: Control how fresh challenge questions increase transfer demand without adding unapproved mathematics or faking official provenance.
official_source_rule: Official exam/year/question attribution is allowed only when an exact official source is verified.
generated_question_label_rule: Fresh items influenced by competition archives must be described as generated/original competitive-style practice, never as official past questions.
curriculum_boundary: Competitive material can change problem design and reasoning demand, not curricular authority.
